## Status

Status is a declared field. Authors set it. It is not inferred from git or CI.

<div class="entity-table">
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th>Value</th><th>Kind</th><th>Meaning</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>draft</code></td><td data-label="Kind">live</td><td data-label="Meaning">Being written</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>ready-for-implementation</code></td><td data-label="Kind">live</td><td data-label="Meaning">Approved to plan</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>implemented</code></td><td data-label="Kind">live</td><td data-label="Meaning">The work was delivered. Still a full spec.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>replaced</code></td><td data-label="Kind">terminal</td><td data-label="Meaning">A named successor took over. Requires replaced-by.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>canceled</code></td><td data-label="Kind">terminal</td><td data-label="Meaning">Abandoned. A reason is optional.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>deprecated</code></td><td data-label="Kind">terminal</td><td data-label="Meaning">Retired without a single named successor.</td></tr>
<tr><td data-label="Value"><code>obsoleted</code></td><td data-label="Kind">terminal</td><td data-label="Meaning">Shipped, then removed with no 1:1 successor. Requires obsoleted-by.</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>

<div class="entity-illegal">
<p>Illegal</p>
<ul>
<li>Any other status name</li>
<li><code>replaced</code> without <code>replaced-by</code></li>
<li><code>obsoleted</code> without <code>obsoleted-by</code></li>
<li>A spec with no bundle</li>
<li>Two plans for one spec</li>
</ul>
</div>

## Constraints

- Feature work uses bundle → spec → plan
- Each spec has exactly one plan
- Do not hand-write a spec into existence
- Specs are never created from issues

## Validate

<pre><code>backstop artifact validate --spec SPEC-NNN</code></pre>

## Reviewer

`spec-reviewer`. Independent of the spec author. Runs after the file validates.

- Reads the source bundle and the spec
- Checks requirement coverage, claims, and mandated tests
- Findings go back to the spec author
- Planning does not start on a spec that failed review

## Notes

Feature work uses bundle → spec → plan. A spec does not exist on its own.

Product code is not written from the spec. The implementer executes an approved plan.
